svg.text: Figure 2 circRNA-mRNA network in HCC (103 circRNAs, 91 genes)
Outer ring: circRNAs (red = up, blue = down) Inner ring: host genes (colour = prognostic significance, size = number of circRNAs)
gene node size = number of circRNAs
Gene node colour: dark red P_cox<0.001 | red P<0.01 | light red P<0.05 | grey not significant
